 C.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Steve Gomez, Public Safety Director, announced that the city has a security camera rebate program
available for residents and the business community.

Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager, provided an update on Public Works maintenance
activities, City Hall Roof Replacement Project, and C Robert Lee Activity Center Reroofing Project; and
announced that the city received a Supplemental Agreement from Caltrans, and we will receive $1.5
million for improving Norwalk and Pioneer Blvd.

Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, provided an update on the implementation of
OpenGov software, and provided an update on the building division.

Linda Hollinsworth, Finance Director, announced that Alex Tires, joined YEP Program; provided an
update on the fee study; and announced the a kickoff meeting was held for the ERP implementation
project.

Ernesto Marquez, City Manager, provided Recreation updates, September 12, 2025 is the last concert
in the park; flag football commences next week; and due to the reroofing of the building, the reception
area is closed, but the building is open and recreation programming continues.

D.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

There were no Oral City Attorney Reports.

E.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Councilmember Vargas asked about fireworks citations.

Ernesto Marquez, City Manager, spoke.

Councilmember Roa spoke regarding no parking near a stop sign.

Mayor De Paula, started his appreciation that the city proclaimed September as Attendance Awareness
Month; and requested a Civic League item to come back.

F.  CLOSED SESSION

1.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Pursuant to Government Code Section 54957
  Title: City Manager

  Norma Tabares, City Attorney, read the Closed Session items into the record.

  The City Council recessed to Closed Session at 7:02 PM.

  The City Council reconvened from Closed Session at 7:23 PM.

  Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, conducted a roll call and announced a quorum.

  Norma Tabares, City Attorney, stated no reportable action from Closed Session.
